predictions.text: Canvas notice: the instructor moved the lab practical to Thursday.
Need to understand eigenvectors before the next university tutorial.
Registration opens for the community college evening class.
Accounts team accepted the revised campaign handover from the agency.

Sam will cover the branch review while the account lead is away.
Moved part of the rainy-day balance into a fixed deposit.
The interest credit differs from the amount on my quarterly statement.
Work out advance tax after the pension contribution deduction.
The linen duvet arrived in the wrong size. The merchant supplied a return label.
Compare the two water filters before placing the order.
Grocery app says the refund will reach the original payment method.
Our neighbor gave me a cutting. Keep it near the shaded kitchen window.
Dad told the story about the road outside his childhood home again.
Add more cardamom next time I make the birthday cake.
Stay near the bus depot because the intercity service leaves before dawn.
The apartment host sent self check-in instructions for our trip.
My transit pass works between the airport and the downtown station.
The optometrist wants another eye exam after six months.
Keep a log of headaches to show the GP at the consultation.
Pharmacy substituted a generic. Check the instructions on the label.
My errands for tomorrow: feed the cat, put out recycling, and call the caretaker.
Check the hallway light and send the reading to the property manager.
Reminder to return the borrowed umbrella before I leave.
The JWT middleware now rejects an expired identity token.
Use git bisect to find the change that broke the lint job.
The router loses the DHCP lease every time it restarts.
Save the illustrated field guide for future plant identification.
Reading list: archived oral history recordings and design journals.
Bookmark the museum catalogue and its bibliography for later.
